x1a2_carcara.name: CCL X1A2 Carcará
x1a2_carcara.authority: Main ruled the Brazil line on 2026-10-29 (DECISIONS) on the owner's request the same day ("lets build brazil, not taiwan, and flesh it out with all its own tanks"): the X1A2 at tier I, a photo-class first-party build on the Bernardini X1 family's build; no registered 3D comparison exists. Numerical 3D comparison remains unverified.
x1a2_carcara.envelopeBasis: Width, length and tallest are the as-built envelope of the X1 family build: published 6.06 m (taken as the hull; Tanks Encyclopedia gives it both ways), 2.6 m wide (its table 2.4), 2.45 m high, 19 t; stations from Gaydos' profile scaled on the hull (the turret roof reads 2.51 m against the published 2.45, recorded as a conflict). The envelope holds the bustle's spare links, the rack, the swing-arm .50 and the raked whip.
